name: Fireburst, Lesser
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level bloodrager 1, magus 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a pinch of sulfur)

EFFECT

Range 5 ft.
Area burst centered on you
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You burst forth with a flash of flame dealing 1d4 fire damage per caster level (maximum 5d4) to all creatures within the burst, except for you or creatures occupying your square. A successful Reflex save halves this damage. Flammable materials burn if the flames touch them. A character can extinguish burning items as a full-round action.
